name: comp-503

frames.best_why: Day 18 is picked and the time reads 12:14:30 PM, showing both halves in use.

tagline: Month calendar with a clock field for entering an exact time.
summary: A single month calendar in a bordered panel, with a divider below and a label reading Enter time. The time field shows hours, minutes and seconds beside a clock icon, and days circle in white when pressed.
appearance: A tall black panel holds "November 2026" between two angle arrows, weekday initials and five weeks of numbers, then a hairline divider and a small "Enter time" caption. A wide rounded field with a clock glyph on its left holds a 12-hour time with AM/PM.
behaviour: Pressing a day fills it with a white circle and clears the previous one; hovering leaves a softer ring. The time field accepts typed hours, minutes and seconds in place, each segment highlighting blue while it is edited. Nothing submits.
demo_content: November 2026 with day 18 chosen and the time set to 12:14:30 PM; the caption credits the calendar library.
search_phrases: calendar with a time field underneath
pick a day and set the clock time
date and time picker in one box
schedule an appointment with hour and minute
choose a date then type the time
use_when: An event needs both a day and a clock time and you want them in one compact panel.
avoid_when: The time field is not tied to the calendar, so the picked day and typed time are never combined or saved.
customise: The default time of 12:00:00 and the caption link are written in the file; day selection, month limits and field styling come from the shared calendar and input.
weight_why: One month grid and a native time field; nothing animates.

a11y.note: The time field has a linked label and native keyboard entry, and days are real buttons; the chosen date is not announced outside the grid.

issues: The time field is never combined with the selected day.
No summary shows the chosen date and time together.
The caption credits the calendar library instead of the control.
polish_why: Neat calendar and tidy time row, but the two halves never talk and the styling is standard.
title: Calendar With Time Input
